units.source_text: 白居易赠驾部吴郎中七兄诗中有句云：“四月天气和且清，绿槐阴合沙隄平。”

en.t: In a poem Bai Juyi presented to Wu Langzhong, his seventh elder brother, of the Bureau of Carriages, there are lines that say: “In the fourth month the weather is mild and clear; the green locust trees cast joined shade, and the sandy embankment lies level.”
See volume nineteen of the complete works.
